messages:
Jia: Swing-shift handoff — quick async check-in. Two active items: (1) kvcache circuit breaker has been tripping intermittently in us-west-2 for embed reads, causing ~5-10% of requests to fall back and latency spikes; (2) embedding quality regression flagged on model-redwood-v2-small for short prompts (small but noticeable drift).

oncall-bot: Incident INC-4022 created for kvcache circuit breaker (P2). Pager notified.

Alex: Got it. What mitigations are live right now?

Jia: Mitigations done: rolled back the batching-window tweak from the 03:00 deploy, bumped cb timeout to 30s, and enabled the read-fallback route to the read-only embed cache for affected pods. Also shifted ~10% of embed traffic to dedicated-embeds pool as a safety valve.

Samira: Logs show eviction bursts right before the CB trips. snippet: ```
2026-03-16T21:08:12Z kvcache[embed-node-7] evict triggered keys=421 size_mb=1266 free_mb=34
2026-03-16T21:08:12Z kvcache[embed-node-7] cb: trip_count=1 reason=eviction_spike
2026-03-16T21:08:12Z kvcache[embed-node-5] pressure=0.82 put_latency=12ms
```

Matt: Plan: increase cache allocation on the affected ASG by +20% (infra ticket created) and ship a small TTL-dampening patch to avoid write storms. I'll run a canary at 22:15 PT (will route 5% traffic). PR is up: #3421.

Jia: Sounds good — canary plan approved. Blocker: need a temporary quota bump for the ASG; Samira, can you follow infra ticket INF-3277?

Samira: On it — INF-3277 raised, added notes, pinging infra.

Alex: Quick reminder: code review ping to @Matt on PR #3421 (ttl-dampening). If we merge, prefer small canary then 30min watch.

Samira: On the embedding-quality regression: evaluation across the short-prompt suite shows a ~3% decrease in similarity for v2-small vs v1 baseline for inputs < 32 tokens. If the model continues to drift after mitigations, fallback option is to route short prompts to model-redwood-v1. I uploaded the eval diff to the team gist: https://redwood.gists/eval/8342 (summary in the gist).

Jia: What I did in my shift: rolled back batching change, enabled fallback route, opened INC-4022 and INF-3277, and alerted downstream teams. Blockers: infra quota bump pending, need PR review linger. Today/next: monitor canary, increase cache on canary nodes, and be ready to flip short-prompt routing to v1 if we see quality regression continue.

Matt: Canary scheduled 22:15 PT. Will post canary results here (latency/eviction rates). Command I'll use to validate memory/pressure: ```kubectl top pod -n embeds -l app=redwood-embed --containers``` and `redis-cli --rdb stats` on the cache pods.

oncall-bot: Alert policy: kvcache_cb_trips silenced for 30m; will re-evaluate.

Alex: If anything looks off during canary, revert traffic and escalate. I'll be around for the first 45 minutes to help.

Jia: End handoff — next check @Alex in ~2h or sooner if alerts. My shift ends at 02:00 PT. Please add short status updates here rather than new threads. Thanks! :thumbsup:
